title: A Two-Component Poro-viscoelastic System for Fibre-Reinforced Hydrogels: Analysis and Homogenization
summary: We study the multiscale behavior of a coupled visco-poroelastic system arising in the modelling of fibre-reinforced hydrogels (FIHs) used in tissue engineering scaffolds. The composite material consists of a periodic fibre scaffold, which is governed by quasi-static linear elasticity, and a hydrogel phase saturating the interstitial space, which is modelled as a Biot linear poroelastic medium enhanced with Kelvin--Voigt structural damping.
